info.name: Dark Elegance YouTube Theme
info.description:
Transform your YouTube experience with the Dark Elegance theme, crafted to provide a sleek and modern look. Immerse yourself in a stunning visual experience with a soothing dark background that reduces eye strain during late-night binge-watching sessions. Key elements such as the video player, sidebar, and links are seamlessly integrated with a refined color palette, enhancing readability and adding a touch of sophistication to your browsing.

Features:

Background: Deep dark grey (#1e1e1e) for a smooth and calming visual experience.

Text: Crisp white text (#ffffff) for clear and easy reading.

Video Player: Elegant black background (#000000) to make your videos pop.

Sidebar and Comments: Subtle dark grey (#2e2e2e) to keep focus on the main content.

Links: Bold red (#ff0000) for a striking contrast and easy navigation.

Perfect for users who enjoy a minimalist and visually appealing interface while browsing YouTube. Elevate your viewing pleasure with Dark Elegance!
